preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**5 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Length of each string is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == len(B) == n for n, A, B in zip(ns, As, Bs))
preconditions.description: Strings A and B have the same length for each test case.

preconditions.expression: all(all('a' <= char <= 't' for char in A) for A in As)
preconditions.description: String A consists of the first 20 lowercase English alphabet letters.

preconditions.expression: all(all('a' <= char <= 't' for char in B) for B in Bs)
preconditions.description: String B consists of the first 20 lowercase English alphabet letters.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)

postconditions.description: Each result is either -1 or a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(result == -1 or (A == B for A, B in zip(As, Bs)) for result, A, B in zip(results, As, Bs))
postconditions.description: If result is not -1, then strings A and B are equal after the specified number of moves.
